```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
library(MartysGas)
```

This vignette demonstrates basic loading of gas meter data and
calculation of heating degree metrics.  The example mirrors the early
analysis steps found in `inst/iter2.r`.

```{r example}
# sample synthetic data
set.seed(1)
dates <- seq(as.POSIXct("2024-01-01"), length.out = 6, by = "1 day")
meter <- cumsum(c(0, runif(5, 0.8, 1.2)))
fun <- create_meter_fun(dates, meter)
rate <- approx_rate(fun, dates)

head(data.frame(Date = dates, Meter = meter, Rate = rate))
```
